messages:
Kate: FYI, noticed weird numeric drift in mistral2-7b q4_0 after promote to dedicated canary. A couple of simple math prompts are coming back wrong.
Arjun: can you drop 1-2 concrete examples and the prompt text?
Kate: example A - prompt: "Compute 17 * 24". output: "354" (expected 408). example B - multi-step column multiplication, it invents an extra carry leading to 93 -> 103. behavior is nondeterministic across samples.
Sara: did the quant conversion match the offline pipeline flags? config mismatches are a frequent root cause.
Kate: conversion args: q4_0, per-channel symmetric scales, act-order folding = disabled. runtime used kernel-set v2.3 but reports a fallback to generic GEMM in logs.
Henry: logs + kernel trace? fallback to generic GEMM under 4-bit can cause precision issues.
Kate: pasted snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T09:21:12Z] model_load: applied quantized weights q4_0
[2026-03-15T09:21:13Z] kernel_select: selected generic_gemm for layer 12 (fallback)
[2026-03-15T09:21:13Z] kv_cache: warm
[2026-03-15T09:21:20Z] decode: token_prob_spike detected
```
Arjun: ok that kernel fallback is suspicious. Can you reproduce locally with a fixed seed?
Kate: reproduced locally seed=73; same error. switching to q8_0 or fp16 gives correct arithmetic answers.
Elena: quick triage checklist: 1) reproduce locally (done), 2) run fp16/q8 baseline (done), 3) run math-suite eval for accuracy/perp, 4) collect quant metadata and kernel trace, 5) open ticket.
Kate: math-suite: fp16 perp=2.0, q4_0 perp=3.8. arithmetic accuracy dropped 94% -> 70% on the subset.
Henry: substantial regression. next steps: compare activations per-layer between fp16 and q4, and force-use optimized kernels vs generic to see diff.
Sara: common mismatch: act-order folding flag at conversion time vs runtime expectation. If converter emits unfolded but kernel expects folded layout, scales will be wrong.
Kate: dumping artifact meta now. sample metadata:
```
quant_meta_layer11: { folded: false, scale_min: -1.24, scale_max: 1.26 }
```
Elena: if runtime kernels assume folded:true, that's definitely a mismatch. add a sanity check in onboarding: verify converted metadata matches runtime kernel expectations.
ops-bot: @eng-runtime ticket created INF-2148 "mistral2-7b q4_0 arithmetic regression on dedicated canary" https://tracker/redwood/INF-2148
Arjun: assign to runtime and cc research + quant team. Also add rollback/gating to rollout policy.
Kate: reverted canary traffic back to q8_0/fp16 and pinned model to previous stable. updating rollout rules to block q4_0 until further notice.
Henry: for root cause investigation: A) re-run quant with forced optimized kernel path; B) run per-layer activation diffs and log distribution of quant scales; C) test per-channel asymmetric scales as an alternate.
Sara: long-term fixes: 1) add deterministic numeric-unit tests for small prompts across quant configs; 2) require kernel_trace artifact on every quant build; 3) add an eval-suite delta gate in rollout pipeline.
Kate: creating short post to eng-ml summarizing steps + linking INF-2148. status: traffic reverted, local repro + metadata captured, ticket opened. next: runtime to validate kernel path and research to try re-quant configs.
Arjun: will ping @runtime-team in 30m if no update :eyes:
Kate: will follow up. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
